# TinyPinyin 2.0.3

Runtime dependency for library pinyin and initials search: `com.github.promeg:tinypinyin:2.0.3`.

Source: [promeG/TinyPinyin, v2.0.3](https://github.com/promeG/TinyPinyin/tree/c4c65b9c0c82cc8e60ef081e91f3cc66b7829dcc).
The original Apache-2.0 [LICENSE](LICENSE) is retained without changes. The published POM omits license metadata; release inventory resolves this coordinate to the versioned upstream license.

Its runtime dependency `org.ahocorasick:ahocorasick:0.3.0` declares Apache-2.0 in its published Maven POM. The release license collector preserves its POM and embedded notices through the normal inventory workflow.
